verdicts.reason: The two candidates are effectively identical, so I scored this pair a tie with the same score. In both, the RSVP Free CTA has shrunk to the size of the Free Entry/All Ages/Tastings pills, so the call to action is lost among the badges. The time and venue line is split off from 'Saturday 21 June' and pushed to the far right, past the product can. The SOLSTICE logo is tiny and isolated at the far right. 'Reserve a spot' sits under the subtitle in a crowded left column, which jumbles the reading order. There is also a stray red fragment after the Tastings pill, left over from the missing partner asset.
